prompt: I want a habit tracker, no login, saved across my phone and laptop, and reminders should be automatic.

ambiguities.description: Cross-device persistence without login needs a project identity mechanism.
ambiguities.answer: Use a shareable sync code, no accounts.

ambiguities.description: Automatic could mean reminders or automatically marking completion.
ambiguities.answer: Send a daily reminder; never mark a habit done automatically.

prompt: A simple grocery list for the whole family. Anyone should be able to add things and it needs to update instantly, even when reception is bad.

ambiguities.description: Who counts as family, and how is list access shared?
ambiguities.answer: Anyone with a private list link can read and edit it, without accounts.

ambiguities.description: Instant shared edits and bad reception require offline and merge semantics.
ambiguities.answer: Queue offline edits and merge additions; a checked item stays checked.

prompt: Make a smart study planner for my exams. It should automatically adjust my schedule when I miss a day, but never move the things I already planned.

ambiguities.description: Smart scheduling needs a defined priority and workload rule.
ambiguities.answer: Prioritize the nearest exam, with at most two hours of studying each day.

ambiguities.description: Automatic rescheduling conflicts with not moving existing plans.
ambiguities.answer: Keep manually scheduled events fixed and move only generated study blocks.

prompt: I need a public RSVP page for a club event, no sign-up, one ticket per person, and a waitlist that just handles itself. We need to export the list later.

ambiguities.description: One ticket per person without sign-up requires duplicate prevention.
ambiguities.answer: Use an email address to prevent duplicate RSVPs; no account creation.

ambiguities.description: Self-managing waitlist needs a promotion and notification rule.
ambiguities.answer: When someone cancels, offer the next person a spot by email for 24 hours.

ambiguities.description: Export format and included personal data are undefined.
ambiguities.answer: Export a CSV with name, email, RSVP time and ticket status, visible only to the organizer.

prompt: A private notes app. Nothing should go to the cloud, and I want the same notes on my laptop and phone. It must work offline too.

ambiguities.description: Sync across devices without a cloud needs an explicit transfer mechanism.
ambiguities.answer: For version one use manual encrypted file export and import between devices.

ambiguities.description: Private could mean local storage or encryption against device access.
ambiguities.answer: Encrypt local notes using a passphrase, which is never stored.

prompt: Build an expense splitter for my roommates. Everyone sees everything but each expense should be private. No accounts. Remind people who owe money automatically.

ambiguities.description: Everyone sees everything conflicts with private expenses.
ambiguities.answer: All roommates see group totals, but only participants see the details of an expense.

ambiguities.description: Roommate identity and access without accounts need a mechanism.
ambiguities.answer: Give each roommate a private invitation link tied to their identity.

ambiguities.description: Automatic reminders need a channel, consent and cadence.
ambiguities.answer: Send one opt-in email reminder a week, and never send payments automatically.

prompt: A smart tool to clean up my downloads, remove duplicates, and organize everything automatically. I really cannot lose any files.

ambiguities.description: Duplicate could mean identical bytes, names or visually similar files.
ambiguities.answer: Only identical file contents, verified by a content hash, count as duplicates.

ambiguities.description: Automatic removal conflicts with not losing files.
ambiguities.answer: Move duplicates to a review folder and require approval before any deletion.

ambiguities.description: Smart organization does not specify folder rules or metadata processing.
ambiguities.answer: Group by file extension and month; do not read document content or send it to an AI.

prompt: We need a fair volunteer shift scheduler for a small nonprofit. Assign people automatically based on availability, let them swap, and never leave a shift empty.

ambiguities.description: Fairness needs a measurable assignment rule.
ambiguities.answer: Balance assigned hours across volunteers over the current month, subject to availability.

ambiguities.description: Swapping and guaranteed coverage need approval and cancellation rules.
ambiguities.answer: Require the replacement volunteer and an organizer to approve a swap; alert the organizer if no cover exists.
